# Style the 404 page like the home page: implementation plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Any unknown URL returns a real `404` and shows the app's own 404 page, in `PitchLayout` with `AppHeader`, with a "Back to home" main button.

**Architecture:** One new synchronous Server Component (`src/app/not-found.tsx`), the shadcn/ui Button generated by the CLI (only `buttonVariants` is used, on a `next/link` `<Link>`), its tests, and a new section in the design guide.

**Tech Stack:** Next.js 16.4.3 (App Router, `cacheComponents: true`), shadcn/ui 4.23.0 (base-nova, Base UI 1.9.0), Tailwind CSS 4.3.4, Vitest with Testing Library and jsdom, Node 24.

**Spec:** [design.md](design.md). Branch: `52-styled-not-found-page`.

## Global Constraints

- `not-found.tsx` stays synchronous: no `async`/`await`, no `headers()`/`cookies()`, no `<Suspense>`, and no root `loading.tsx`.
- The link is `<Link href="/">` with `className={cn(buttonVariants(), "h-12 w-full px-8 font-heading text-xl font-extrabold italic uppercase md:w-auto")}`, with `cn` from `@/lib/utils`. Never `buttonVariants({ className })`: cva appends it without removing conflicts, so `h-8` and `h-12` would both stay. Never `<Button render={<Link />} nativeButton={false}>`.
- Copy, exactly: heading "404" (volt) then "Page not found."; lead "This page doesn't exist or has moved."; button "Back to home"; title `` `Page not found · ${APP_NAME}` ``.
- In the code we write: theme tokens and Tailwind's default scales only, no `[…]` values, no hex, no palette colors. `src/components/ui/button.tsx` is generated and not hand-edited.
- The app name only through `APP_NAME` from `@/lib/app-name`.
- Stage by explicit path only. Every commit message ends with `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.
- Before every commit: `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run format:check`. `npm run build` before the PR.

## Review Focus

- **The real status code:** an unknown URL must answer `404`, not `200` with a 404 body. Unit tests can't see this; Task 3 checks it with `curl` against a production build.
- **Nested unknown URLs** (`/a/b/c`, `/does-not-exist/`) show the same page with `404`. Task 3 curls one nested URL too.
- **Keyboard focus** on "Back to home" shows the grey ring (`focus-visible:ring-ring/50`), never volt. Task 1 asserts no `ring-primary`/`outline-primary` class on the link; Task 3 checks it by eye with Tab.
- **Narrow phones (320–390 px):** the heading and the full-width button fit without horizontal scroll (`whitespace-nowrap` on the button). Task 3 checks it at 390 px, and at 320 px if a browser can be driven.
- **The home page is unchanged:** its test still finds exactly one link, to `/`. Task 1 runs the whole suite.

Expect `src/components/ui/button.tsx` exporting `Button` and `buttonVariants`, importing `cn` from `"cn"`, and no other file changed (check `git status`; if `package.json` or `components.json` changed, stop and report).
- [ ] **Step 2: Commit it.** `git add src/components/ui/button.tsx` and commit with `git commit -m "chore: add the shadcn/ui Button" -m "Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"`.
- [ ] **Step 3: Write the failing tests** in `src/app/__tests__/not-found.test.tsx`, in the style of `page.test.tsx`:

```tsx
test("the 404 page has the heading, with 404 in volt", () => {
  render(<NotFound />);
  expect(
    screen.getByRole("heading", { level: 1, name: "404 Page not found." }),
  ).toBeDefined();
  expect(screen.getByText("404").className).toContain("text-primary");
});

test("the 404 page shows the lead text", () => {
  render(<NotFound />);
  expect(
    screen.getByText("This page doesn't exist or has moved."),
  ).toBeDefined();
});

test("Back to home is one link to /, styled as the main button", () => {
  render(<NotFound />);
  const links = screen.getAllByRole("link", { name: "Back to home" });
  expect(links).toHaveLength(1);
  expect(links[0].getAttribute("href")).toBe("/");
  expect(links[0].className).toContain("bg-primary");
  expect(links[0].className).toContain("text-primary-foreground");
  expect(links[0].className).toContain("h-12");
  expect(links[0].className).toContain("text-xl");
  expect(links[0].className).not.toMatch(/(^|\s)(h-8|text-sm)(\s|$)/);
  expect(links[0].className).not.toMatch(/(ring|outline)-primary/);
  expect(screen.queryAllByRole("button")).toHaveLength(0);
});

test("the header shows the app name", () => {
  render(<NotFound />);
  expect(screen.getByRole("banner").textContent).toBe(APP_NAME);
});

test("the 404 page has its own title, built from the app name", () => {
  expect(metadata.title).toBe(`Page not found · ${APP_NAME}`);
});
```

### Task 2: Design guide

**Files:** Modify: `docs/reference/design-guide.md`

- [ ] **Step 1:** Add a "Main button" section after Page layout: it's the page's one main action, in volt (one of volt's three uses); its classes, `cn(buttonVariants(), "h-12 w-full px-8 font-heading text-xl font-extrabold italic uppercase md:w-auto")` with `cn` from `@/lib/utils`, and why not `buttonVariants({ className })` (cva keeps the clashing defaults) (default variant: `bg-primary text-primary-foreground`, `rounded-lg`, grey focus ring); a short `<Link href="/" className={cn(buttonVariants(), "…")}>Back to home</Link>` example; and a note that a real action, such as a form submit, uses `<Button>` with the same classes.
